intent: Count how many of the 6 specified product variants have available_today_quantity >= 1 in the Lend district PowerTool store today.

params.fam1: %Liqui Moly Workshop Top Tec LMI-I9R Automotive Cleaner%
params.fam6: %Raaco Stackable Assorter 20C-L8E Storage Bin and Organizer%

success_criteria: Resolve the Lend district PowerTool store_id
Each of the 6 variants matched by brand + family line + specified properties
Availability tested via store_inventory.available_today_quantity >= 1 for that store
Answer is the count of matched-available variants in exact format qty=%d

args.stdin: SELECT store_id, store_name, city, record_path FROM stores WHERE store_name LIKE :store OR city = :city;

WITH lend AS (SELECT store_id FROM stores WHERE store_name LIKE :store OR city = :city) SELECT (CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM product_variants v JOIN product_families f ON f.product_family_id=v.product_family_id JOIN store_inventory si ON si.product_sku=v.product_sku AND si.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lend) JOIN product_variant_properties pa ON pa.product_sku=v.product_sku AND pa.property_key=:k1a AND pa.property_value_text=:v1a JOIN product_variant_properties pb ON pb.product_sku=v.product_sku AND pb.property_key=:k1b AND pb.property_value_number=:v1b WHERE f.brand=:b1 AND f.product_family_name LIKE :fam1 AND si.available_today_quantity>=1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM product_variants v JOIN product_families f ON f.product_family_id=v.product_family_id JOIN store_inventory si ON si.product_sku=v.product_sku AND si.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lend) JOIN product_variant_properties pa ON pa.product_sku=v.product_sku AND pa.property_key=:k2a AND pa.property_value_text=:v2a JOIN product_variant_properties pb ON pb.product_sku=v.product_sku AND pb.property_key=:k2b AND pb.property_value_number=:v2b WHERE f.brand=:b2 AND f.product_family_name LIKE :fam2 AND si.available_today_quantity>=1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM product_variants v JOIN product_families f ON f.product_family_id=v.product_family_id JOIN store_inventory si ON si.product_sku=v.product_sku AND si.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lend) JOIN product_variant_properties pa ON pa.product_sku=v.product_sku AND pa.property_key=:k3a AND pa.property_value_text=:v3a JOIN product_variant_properties pb ON pb.product_sku=v.product_sku AND pb.property_key=:k3b AND pb.property_value_number=:v3b WHERE f.brand=:b3 AND f.product_family_name LIKE :fam3 AND si.available_today_quantity>=1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM product_variants v JOIN product_families f ON f.product_family_id=v.product_family_id JOIN store_inventory si ON si.product_sku=v.product_sku AND si.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lend) JOIN product_variant_properties pa ON pa.product_sku=v.product_sku AND pa.property_key=:k4a AND pa.property_value_text=:v4a JOIN product_variant_properties pb ON pb.product_sku=v.product_sku AND pb.property_key=:k4b AND pb.property_value_number=:v4b WHERE f.brand=:b4 AND f.product_family_name LIKE :fam4 AND si.available_today_quantity>=1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM product_variants v JOIN product_families f ON f.product_family_id=v.product_family_id JOIN store_inventory si ON si.product_sku=v.product_sku AND si.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lend) JOIN product_variant_properties pa ON pa.product_sku=v.product_sku AND pa.property_key=:k5a AND pa.property_value_text=:v5a JOIN product_variant_properties pb ON pb.product_sku=v.product_sku AND pb.property_key=:k5b AND pb.property_value_number=:v5b WHERE f.brand=:b5 AND f.product_family_name LIKE :fam5 AND si.available_today_quantity>=1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM product_variants v JOIN product_families f ON f.product_family_id=v.product_family_id JOIN store_inventory si ON si.product_sku=v.product_sku AND si.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lend) JOIN product_variant_properties pa ON pa.product_sku=v.product_sku AND pa.property_key=:k6a AND pa.property_value_text=:v6a JOIN product_variant_properties pb ON pb.product_sku=v.product_sku AND pb.property_key=:k6b AND pb.property_value_text=:v6b JOIN product_variant_properties pc ON pc.product_sku=v.product_sku AND pc.property_key=:k6c AND pc.property_value_number=:v6c WHERE f.brand=:b6 AND f.product_family_name LIKE :fam6 AND si.available_today_quantity>=1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS qty;

agents_md_constraints.rule: When answering availability questions - answer should reference products that are available, but should not reference unavailable products. Same with stores.
When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
